item.title: Fiji suffers 8-1 defeat to Senegal in U17 Futsal Youth Olympic Games opener
item.description: Fiji has suffered a heavy 8-1 defeat to Senegal in its opening match of the U17 Futsal at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games. Senegal made a perfect start to its campaign, dominating the match to secure a convincing victory over the Fijian side.
item.content:encoded:
Fiji has suffered a heavy 8-1 defeat to Senegal in its opening match of the U17 Futsal at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games.

Senegal made a perfect start to its campaign, dominating the match to secure a convincing victory over the Fijian side.

Fiji will look to bounce back when it takes on Ukraine on Wednesday before facing Venezuela on Friday.

The team will be hoping to improve its performance and get its campaign back on track in its remaining pool matches.

item.title: Bulikula will back their style of footy ahead of Jillaroos semi-final clash - Coach
item.description: The Vodafone Bulikula have a style of footy they believe in, and the players remain committed to it, backing their skills and execution to finish tough games against any opposition. Speaking from Australia, the Bulikula's defensive coach Isaac Michael expressed confidence in his players ahead of their clash against the Jillaroos in the Rugby League World Cup semi-final.
item.content:encoded:
The Vodafone Bulikula have a style of footy they believe in, and the players remain committed to it, backing their skills and execution to finish tough games against any opposition.

Speaking from Australia, the Bulikula's defensive coach Isaac Michael expressed confidence in his players ahead of their clash against the Jillaroos in the Rugby League World Cup semi-final.

Michael says they will put together their best players to get the job done.

He says there are no major injuries in the team and the players are recovering well.

The Bulikula will face the Jillaroos this Sunday at 6.45pm at the Allianz Stadium in Sydney.
